name: FXOapps Product Filter for WooCommerce
author: FXOapps

sections.description:
FXOapps Product Filter for WooCommerce adds a storefront filter to shop, category, tag, attribute, and search pages. Shoppers narrow the catalog by category, attribute, price, stock, sale, featured, and rating. You choose checkbox, radio, or dropdown for each filter, and the product grid updates with AJAX or a full page reload.

This WordPress.org release is a complete sidebar filter. There is no product cap, no filter cap, and no license key. Checkbox, radio, dropdown, the style editor, load more, and infinite scroll all work here. Product Filter PRO is a separate plugin. The Product Filter PRO section below is what that plugin includes.

What this free plugin includes

✓ Archives — shop, category, tag, attribute, and product search
✓ Unlimited filters — category, tag, attribute, custom taxonomy, price, stock, on sale, featured, and rating
✓ Display — checkbox, radio, and dropdown
✓ Categories — parent and child lists, counts, hide empty values, and collapsible groups
✓ Price — minimum and maximum fields
✓ Results — AJAX grid updates, or a full page reload with filter URLs
✓ Pagination — numbered pages, load more, and infinite scroll
✓ Variable products — a product stays visible when a published variation is in stock or on backorder, and attribute filters follow that variation
✓ Placement — auto-insert above the products, the FXOapps Product Filters widget, or the [fxoapps_product_filters] shortcode
✓ Behavior — product counters, content-aware values, and scroll back to the grid after an AJAX update
✓ Index — a product index you rebuild from the settings screen, plus a cache you can clear
✓ Settings — FXOapps → Product Filter, with General, Display, Filters, Appearance, Translations, Indexer, Performance, and Debug tabs

Filters you build here keep working after you install PRO. PRO is a separate plugin. It does not replace this one with a locked copy of the same screen.

Product Filter PRO

Upgrade to Product Filter PRO

FXOapps Product Filter PRO for WooCommerce is a separate plugin. Nothing in this plugin is switched off. The list below is what the PRO plugin includes.

Look
✓ Color swatches, with a hex color or an image for each value
✓ Button chips
✓ Rating stars
✓ Price range slider
✓ Category links

Style
✓ Custom CSS

Layout
✓ Horizontal filter bar
✓ Off-canvas drawer and a Filters button, floating or inline, on mobile, desktop, or both

Catalog
✓ Custom meta filters and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)
✓ In-browser filtering for shop, category, and tag archives

Index and SEO
✓ Scheduled daily or weekly rebuild, and a pause while products are imported
✓ Precache and a background index updater
✓ SEO controls for filtered URLs
✓ License activation and one-click updates from WordPress

Filters you save here keep working after you install PRO. You do not rebuild the filter list from scratch.

Shop owner setup

After activation, open FXOapps → Product Filter and:

  1. General — turn the filter on, choose AJAX or page reload, and set products per page
  2. Display — auto-insert the panel, or use the widget or the [fxoapps_product_filters] shortcode
  3. Filters — add category, attribute, price, stock, and the other sources, then choose checkbox, radio, or dropdown
  4. Indexer — rebuild the product index so counts and results match the catalog
  5. Pro features — read what the separate PRO plugin includes, and upgrade to Product Filter PRO if you want that plugin
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate FXOapps Product Filter for WooCommerce through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  4. Open FXOapps → Product Filter, build your filters, and rebuild the index.
  5. Place the filters with auto-insert, the widget, or [fxoapps_product_filters].
  6. When you want the separate PRO plugin, upgrade to Product Filter PRO. Your saved filters stay in place.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a license?

No. This release filters the catalog without a license key, a trial, or an fxoapps.com account.

Is there a limit on how many filters I can add?

No. Add as many checkbox, radio, and dropdown filters as the catalog needs. There is no product cap.

Does it support variable products?

Yes. When WooCommerce hides out-of-stock items, a variable product stays in the list if a published variation is in stock or on backorder. Attribute filters follow that variation.

What do I get if I upgrade to Product Filter PRO?

Product Filter PRO is a separate plugin. It does not turn anything in this plugin off. The Product Filter PRO section on this page lists what that plugin includes: swatches, button chips, rating stars, a price slider, category links, a horizontal bar, an off-canvas drawer, custom meta and ACF filters, the in-browser engine, scheduled rebuilds, and SEO controls.

You can read a shorter list any time under FXOapps → Product Filter → Pro features.

Will my filters still work after I upgrade to PRO?

Yes. Filters you save in this plugin keep working after you install Product Filter PRO. Upgrade to Product Filter PRO when you want that separate plugin. You do not rebuild the filter list from scratch.

Where can I show the filters?

Use one or more of these: auto-insert on archive pages, the FXOapps Product Filters widget in a sidebar, or the [fxoapps_product_filters] shortcode.

Does the plugin call external services?

No. Filter requests run on your WordPress site. This release does not phone home or contact a license server.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Clearing all filters also clears a minimum and maximum price.
  • Typing in a filter search box narrows button options as well as checkboxes.
  • Clear all keeps the All products row at the top of a category list.

1.0.1

  • Removed the free-edition switch that turned built-in tools off. Drawer, load more, ACF, SEO, scheduling, the style editor, and the toolbar save and run from their own settings.
  • Removed the custom CSS box. Colors are chosen with the style fields.
  • Page-2 hiding uses fixed shop selectors.
  • Storefront strings are translated from literal text.

1.0.0

  • First release of the free filter.
